outer_schedule: Read count then destination. Zero branch rereads destination and returns before fill-byte/feature/destination access.
XOR EAX0 then read low fill byte. Only AL0, unsigned n>=256, current actual109EEA4!=0 selects vector tail, in that order.
Scalar push EDI; n1..3 explicit ascending byte loop. n>=4 computes wrapped -D &3 and emits positive prefix before pattern replication.
Replicate AL with SHL8/ADD then SHL16/ADD; remaining n&3 to EDX, logical n>>2 to ECX. Positive bulk REP STOSD then positive remainder byte loop.
Scalar return reloads original destination at ESP+8 before restoring EDI. No DF change, overflow/null repair or owner.

dispatcher_schedule.remainder: Signed int32 pointer remainder modulo16 via CDQ/XOR/SUB/AND/XOR/SUB; no unsigned modulo replacement.
dispatcher_schedule.aligned: Tail=n&127; if n!=tail call actual engine on n-tail. Positive tail REP STOSB at D+n-tail. Aligned zero skips both.
dispatcher_schedule.misaligned: Prefix16-remainder is1..15 for positive representations,17..31 for negative; write entire prefix before wrapped n-prefix and recursive call.
dispatcher_schedule.short_limit: Direct misaligned short/zero calls may overrun prefix and wrap remaining count. Outer unsigned n>=256 gate supplies enough prefix count in valid nonwrapping extents.

engine_schedule.entry: SHR count7, PXOR XMM0, unconditional JMP over8 padding bytes into first iteration; no zero guard.
engine_schedule.writes: Eight MOVDQA stores at +0,+10,+20,+30,+40,+50,+60,+70 hex in order, then LEA D+80, DEC ECX/JNE.
engine_schedule.count: For direct n>=128, writes floor(n/128)*128 bytes; dispatcher supplies positive128 multiple. Direct n<128 executes first128-byte iteration then loop-count underflow.
engine_schedule.domain: Actual CPU/OS SSE2 support; 16-byte aligned destination and sufficient writable mapped extent. No destination loads or private state.
